title: Hedging Scheduled Political Events: replication code, inputs and results
description: Code, event inputs and results for the paper Hedging Scheduled Political Events with Listed Options: A Mechanical Rule for Long-Only Emerging-Market Investors (Santiago Negrotto, SSRN Working Paper, 2026). The decision protocol in code/framework.py (SHA-256 prefix 221320a15437) was frozen on 11 November 2026 and is archived here unchanged, together with the in-sample run of 11 November 2026 and the final run of 13 November 2026 reported in the paper. The main rule was fixed after the 2026 Brazilian runoff; there was no dated public registration before the events. Version 1.1.0 adds the intrinsic-value marks of the revised paper (code/revision_cuentas.py), computed from the archived record. Purchased option data (iVolatility) and third-party price data (B3, Stooq, FRED) are not included; the repository lists the exact files and ticker-days and provides a download script for the public sources.
